title: ruff I001 x3 in python/src/lichen/crypto/__init__.py fails repo-root ruff check gate
description: Discovered while linting during worker6-xxpn validation. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml line 20) runs uv run --directory python ruff check; python/src/lichen/crypto/__init__.py has 3 un-sorted/un-formatted import blocks (I001, lines ~17, ~26, ~38 - capability_announcements, delegation_tokens, root_dio_signature imports), all autofixable with ruff check --fix. File is committed and untouched by the relay-signer work; the gate is red at HEAD 68c6e60d6f. Note: ruff format drift also exists in python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py and replay.py at HEAD but format is not CI-enforced (only ruff check is), so those are out of scope.
